name: SVR Poker Android
updateMessage: An optional SVR Poker Android update is available.
updateMenuPolicy: Hidden unless releaseReady is true, apkUrl is non-empty, and apkVersionCode is newer than the installed code.
notes: Phase 347 replaces every visible Android control stack with one final MOVE/LOOK controller and one six-button poker action rail.
Horizontal input is corrected so dragging left moves left and dragging right moves right.
SIT now uses the canonical table dimensions and the south/front player seat.
While seated, MOVE is restricted to a left/right slide rail and LOOK remains available within controlled table-view limits.
Two player cards and five community-card slots are shown in the HUD and as Android-only camera-anchored floating cards.
The Android table receives one authoritative center SVR logo and a raised translucent pot display.
Phase 344 remains the single-fire poker action broker and full-hand acceptance recorder.
The optional update menu remains invisible until a real signed APK with a newer version code is published.
No native Android wrapper source, signing identity, or installable APK is currently present in the repository, so the next APK is not falsely marked ready.
Forced updates and recurring update prompts remain disabled.
